title: Modified Meals
description: Changes the recipes of a few food items.
body:
## Modified Meals🥘
Modifies and re-balances the recipes for beetroot stew, bread, cake, cookies, pumpking pie, and rabbit stew in the name of either convienence, greater viablility, or to more sense.

### Below are the recipes and the updated recipes:
<details>
<summary>1. Beetroot Stew</summary>
5x Beetroot, 1x Bowl, Shapeless
</details>
   
<details>
<summary>2. Bread</summary>
3x Wheat, Shapeless
</details>
 
<details>
<summary>3. Cake</summary>
2x Milk Bucket, 1x Sweet Berries, 2x Sugar, 1x Egg, 3x Wheat
</details>

<details>
<summary>4. Cookies</summary>
1x Milk Bucket, 1x Sugar, 1x Wheat, 1x Cocao Beans, Shapeless
</details>
  
<details>
<summary>5. Pumpkin Pie</summary>
1x Milk Bucket, 1x Pumpkin Pie, 1x Sugar, 1x Egg
</details>

<details>
<summary>6. Rabbit Stew</summary>
1x Cooked Rabbit, 1x Bowl, 1x Mushroom
</details>
